## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1 (continued docs coverage): The source-branch bump model should be documented for future maintainers.

## Implementation Notes

Update `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` (or `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md` if more appropriate \xe2\x80\x94 verify which doc covers merge-to-main pipeline phases):

1. Document the new `_phase_source_branch_version_bump` pre-merge phase.
2. Describe the post-merge `_phase_version_bump` no-op detection logic.
3. State the design decision: bump-BEFORE-final-review (link to S5 ticket).
4. Document the sequencing invariant: version file is never in .test-index, so S4's check is order-independent against S5's bump.

Doc-router Gate 2 fired (existing reference doc). Emit DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION in commit message.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` (or COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md) | modify | n/a (instruction file) | still-valid |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Doc covers source-branch bump path
  Verify: grep -qE 'source.branch.*bump|_phase_source_branch_version_bump' plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md 2>/dev/null
- [ ] Doc covers post-merge no-op detection
  Verify: grep -qE 'no.op|already.bump' plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md 2>/dev/null

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
